# University College of the North

> UCN is Northern Manitoba's indigenous-focused higher education institution serving learners across The Pas and Thompson campuses with quality programs, financial support, and commitment to Truth and Reconciliation.

University College of the North (UCN) operates two campuses in Northern Manitoba dedicated to accessible, quality higher education with strong emphasis on indigenous education and community engagement. The institution serves students from across Canada and internationally with comprehensive support services, financial aid, and diverse academic programs.
